title: Concept Acupuncturist: An Efficient and Precise Concept Erasure Method for Diffusion Models via Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.32059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion-based image generation models produce high-quality images but may generate harmful or policy-violating content, motivating machine unlearning (MU) to selectively remove target concepts while preserving general capabilities. However, existing MU approaches often struggle with the distributed and entangled nature of concept representations, leading to inefficient optimization and imprecise edits when applied through large-scale fine-tuning over full diffusion trajectories. translated_title: 概念针灸师：一种基于稀疏自编码器的扩散模型高效精确概念擦除方法
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的图像生成模型能够生成高质量图像，但可能生成有害或违反政策的内容，这促使机器遗忘（MU）技术被用于选择性地移除目标概念，同时保留模型的通用能力。然而，现有的机器遗忘方法往往难以应对概念表示的分布式和纠缠特性，当通过在全扩散轨迹上进行大规模微调来应用时，会导致优化效率低下和编辑不精确。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了概念针灸师（ConceptACP），这是一种新颖的机器遗忘框架，它将可解释性引导的分析与无需推理的微调相结合，以实现高效且精确的概念移除。通过建立语义概念与 U-Net 去噪器中交叉注意力块之间的映射，并定位与概念最相关的块进行针对性优化，ConceptACP 避免了全扩散轨迹的优化，从而提高了（效率与精度）。
tldr: 该论文提出ConceptACP框架，利用稀疏自编码器的可解释性分析定位U-Net去噪器中与目标概念最相关的交叉注意力块并进行针对性微调，从而实现对扩散模型概念的高效精确擦除。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ConceptACP, a machine unlearning framework that leverages sparse autoencoder-based interpretability analysis to localize the most concept-relevant cross-attention block in the U-Net denoiser for targeted fine-tuning, enabling efficient and precise concept erasure in diffusion models.
